items.title: Learn to build better AI Agents through better context
items.creator: DeepLearning.AI
items.summary: DeepLearning.AI and Chroma have launched a course on Context Engineering to address performance degradation and context rot in long-running AI agents. The course teaches how to design systems that provide the right information in the right format and at the right time. Learners gain hands-on experience building context management tools from scratch to control reliability, cost, and latency.
items.key_idea: Learn to manage context from scratch to build more reliable, performant, and cost-effective AI agents.
